name: What happens after the roof leak-source assessment is complete?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the roof leak-source assessment is complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the roof leak-source assessment, our technicians will provide you with a detailed report outlining the identified leak source(s), photos, and a clear explanation of the necessary repairs. We will then discuss the findings with you and offer a transparent estimate for the repair work. This process ensures you understand the issue and proposed solutions before any repair work begins, allowing you to make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Following the assessment, you'll receive a detailed report, photos, and a transparent estimate for necessary repairs.
